## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`
- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Clippy is clean for changed Rust code
- [ ] UI changes were checked on KDE Plasma Wayland
- [ ] Packaging changes passed `packaging/release-check.sh`

List commands run and any checks that were not applicable.

## Risk and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, transcripts, recordings, local configuration, generated packages, or internal audit documents are included
- [ ] New network access is explicit, documented, bounded, and disabled for local-only providers
- [ ] User data and secrets are handled according to the existing privacy boundaries
- [ ] Dependencies and bundled assets have compatible licenses and redistribution terms

## Documentation and release impact

- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented where needed
- [ ] Tests cover regressions where practical
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when the change is release-notable
- [ ] Configuration or storage migrations are backward compatible or clearly documented

## Screenshots

Include before/after images for visible UI changes, with private content removed.
